items.title: Claude solves two open problems in the physics of black holes
items.summary:
Claude has solved two open problems in theoretical physics. Both concern black holes and the search for a theory of quantum gravity. In the first, it completed a calculation that physicists set up more than 20 years ago, but which had never been solved. Claude’s result showed that a sudden transition associated with the formation of black holes persists even where spacetime no longer has a definite shape. In the second, Claude found the exact limit of the simplest version of a technique used to test candidate theories of quantum gravity. This post explains both findings, first in plain terms and then in more technical detail. The preprints are available here and here.

items.title: Show HN: Zpup – Zdog style 3D scenes in JSON, SVG from any angle
items.summary: Hi. I made small project called Zpup. It takes small 3D scene written in JSON and gives back a flat SVG from any angle. There is no JavaScript in the file, so it works in img-tag or README. I needed 3D for small project at my company, and Zdog make big impression on me. But Zdog has not had a release for several years, so I wanted to make modern version. One thing works different. Zdog sorts each shape by one point. so small thing on big floor gets covered when you turn it. Zpup compares the shapes that overlap. You can see both in the README. I wrote it with Claude Code Fable 5.2. No canvas renderer, no text shape, and it is 0.2 version. Playground: https://rxolve.github.io/zpup Feedback is always welcome :)
